name: Avoid sending mail UI
description: Admin listing and add/edit/delete forms for the asm blocklist of email addresses.
project_description: asm_ui is the optional admin interface submodule of Avoid sending mail (asm). Via hook_entity_type_alter() it attaches a list builder, HTML route provider, and add/edit/delete forms to the asm_email_blocked entity, exposing a management page at /admin/config/people/mail-blocked to add, edit, delete and review blocked email addresses. It adds no permissions of its own; access is governed by asm's 'administer asm email blocked' permission.
